provenance: Written from the TypeScript sources of JsonlSessionPersistence list() (listArtifacts, ensureRootEncoding, listProjectDirs, listSessionDirs, resolveGenerationInDirectory, readGenerationHeader, readFirstLine, readFirstZstdLine, assertStoredIdentity, sameFile), sessionFormatCatalog.readHeader, the v0/v1 physical header codec, and the v2-to-v3 header migration, with each expectation authored before running its case in either harness. No value was copied from TypeScript or Rust output.
notes: ts is the production outcome; rust replaces it only where this preview reports a native budget or representation limit. A listed record holds every admitted Session sorted by root-relative path, with the selected generation's filename version and current header. sizeBytes is compared with the built file, following a link, rather than stored here. Entry budgets count every entry of every directory listing in the layout pass and again in the discovery pass.
